items.exampleEn: She was a pioneer in the field of computer science.
items.exampleZh: 她是電腦科學領域的先驅。

items.exampleEn: Her whole argument starts from a false premise.
items.exampleZh: 她整個論點都是從一個錯誤的前提出發。

items.exampleEn: The exploitation of solar energy is growing fast.
items.exampleZh: 太陽能的開發利用正快速成長。

items.exampleEn: A rare frog that was thought to be extinct was rediscovered last year.
items.exampleZh: 一種原以為已經絕種的稀有青蛙，去年被重新發現了。

items.exampleEn: To survive, the old bakery had to innovate.
items.exampleZh: 為了生存，那家老麵包店必須創新。

items.exampleEn: Good facilitation helps a meeting stay on track.
items.exampleZh: 良好的引導能讓會議不偏離主題。

items.sentenceEn: Small firms often innovate faster than big ones.
items.sentenceZh: 小公司往往比大公司更快創新。

items.audioEn: On holiday, I rediscovered the joy of reading paper books.
items.audioZh: 放假時，我重新發現了讀紙本書的樂趣。
items.questionZh: 說話者放假時重新發現了什麼？
options: A love of cooking with friends
An old friend from primary school

items.sentenceEn: Her grandfather pioneered a new way to grow rice.
items.sentenceZh: 她的爺爺開創了一種種稻的新方法。

items.sentenceEn: A trained leader handled the facilitation of the workshop.
items.sentenceZh: 一位受過訓練的主持人負責引導這場工作坊。

items.stemEn: The story is based on a simple ____: what if animals could talk?
items.stemZh: 這個故事建立在一個簡單的前提上：如果動物會說話呢？

items.stemEn: Companies that do not ____ will lose customers to younger rivals.
items.stemZh: 不創新的公司，會把客戶輸給年輕的對手。

items.passageEn: Seventy years ago, a small toy company in our town was a pioneer of plastic toys. Its first owner worked on the premise that children want toys they can build themselves. Later, the company faced criticism for the exploitation of cheap workers abroad and almost closed. A few years ago, the first owner's granddaughter took over. She rediscovered her grandfather's old notebooks and used his ideas to innovate again, this time with wooden toys and simple electronic gadgets. She also hired a trainer for the facilitation of design workshops with local children.
items.passageZh: 七十年前，我們鎮上一家小玩具公司是塑膠玩具的先驅。第一任老闆的經營前提是：孩子想要可以自己組裝的玩具。後來，公司因為剝削海外廉價勞工而遭到批評，差點倒閉。幾年前，第一任老闆的孫女接手經營。她重新找到爺爺的舊筆記本，並用他的點子再次創新，這次做的是木製玩具和簡單的電子小玩意。她也聘請了一位培訓師，引導和當地孩子一起進行的設計工作坊。

questions.questionZh: 第一任老闆的經營前提是什麼？
options: 塑膠玩具比木製玩具更耐用
玩具一定要便宜到人人買得起
大人也會喜歡買玩具給自己

questions.questionZh: 孫女怎麼讓公司再次創新？
options: 請知名設計師重新設計商標
把工廠搬到國外降低成本
只賣塑膠做的電子玩具

items.promptZh: 他是台灣電影的先驅之一。
referenceEn: He was one of the pioneers of Taiwanese film.
He is one of the pioneers of film in Taiwan.
rubricZh: pioneer 是可數名詞，表示「先驅、開拓者」（例如 one of the pioneers of… 等）
「台灣電影」可寫，例如 Taiwanese film、film in Taiwan、Taiwanese movies 等

items.promptZh: 搬家時，她在箱子裡重新發現了小時候寫的日記。
referenceEn: While moving house, she rediscovered the diary she had written as a child.
When she moved, she rediscovered her childhood diary in a box.
rubricZh: 「重新發現」用 rediscover（例如 rediscovered her diary 等）
「小時候寫的日記」可寫，例如 the diary she had written as a child、her childhood diary 等
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 rediscovered 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 plumbing／gadget／carpentry 與「故事建立在一個簡單的___：如果動物會說話呢？」語意完全無關，一眼排除（§11-26）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 干擾項換成抽象名詞 exploitation、credential、renown，只看英文時代入 based on a simple ____ 都不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B 疑似 20：exploitation 卡用童工被剝削，偏沉重；主要釋義是開發、利用
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依裁示改教「開發、利用」：The exploitation of solar energy is growing fast.，釋義改「開發、利用；剝削」，干擾項同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：pioneer 是可數名詞，表示「先驅、開拓者」（例如 one of the pioneers of… 等）／「台灣電影」可寫，例如 Taiwanese film、film in Taiwan、Taiwanese movies 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長最終複審修正：最終複審 11：同詞性題 renown、exploitation 不可數，放不進 a simple ____
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 換成可數的 pioneer（本課）、subordinate（u24），代入後語意不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（rediscover）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u35-l01-q15；目標字沿用 rediscover
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「搬家時，她在箱子裡重新發現了小時候寫的日記。」、hintWords ["rediscover"]、referenceEn ["While moving house, she rediscovered the diary she had written as a child.","When she moved, she rediscovered her childhood diary in a box."]、rubricZh ["「重新發現」用 rediscover（例如 rediscovered her diary 等）","「小時候寫的日記」可寫，例如 the diary she had written as a child、her childhood diary 等","說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 rediscovered 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 rediscover 造一個句子，說說你重新找回的一個興趣或東西。」、referenceEn ["Last summer, I rediscovered my old guitar and started playing again.","I rediscovered how much I enjoy swimming."]）
